page.layout: One printed page, title page. Top: title lines centred in roman and italic capitals. Below: dedication lines, motto with citation, a woodcut emblem with mottoes around it, then imprint lines centred at foot. Handwritten pencil marks at top right are not printed.

main_text.l: Veritati nemo præscribere potest: non spacium temporum:

page.notes: The woodcut emblem shows a hand clasp above a cornucopia-like basket, with the legend "SERVATA FIDES" and "MATHES HARNISCH" and "DITAT" around the ring; it is not transcribed as text. The date reads "M. D. XXCVI." as printed, with the last letters possibly misprinted for XCVI. Handwritten marks at top right are not transcribed.
